scope: Shared bounded root admission for standalone-agent and graph services inside ExecutionPlatform

behavior.reservation_lifetime: Queued, running, and durably paused roots retain a slot; terminal or failed admission releases it.
behavior.capacity: ExecutionPlatform configures queue limit plus agent and graph worker slots.
behavior.dispatch_boundary: Agent and graph services retain separate worker loops; cross-service fairness, ordering, and worker placement remain future work.

validation.build: CMake Release targets agentflow_agent_service_contract and agentflow_runtime passed.
validation.regression: A paused graph blocks standalone-agent admission; a streaming agent blocks graph admission; rejection persists neither the new run nor prompt; completion and cancellation release capacity.
